svg.aria-label: 01. Always Answer. In production. AI agents that answer phone calls, website chats and text messages for businesses in Canada, around the clock. When a customer needs the team, the agent sends them a short summary by text and email. Role: Software engineer. Built: Voice agents, website chat, team alerts, owner dashboard. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, OpenAI Realtime, Claude, Next.js, NestJS, Firebase.
